title: Ingest a PDF into library/ (folio-assistant rungs)
description: Runs folio-assistant's pdf-structure rung on an uploaded PDF. It records the embedded outline as sections with page ranges and the file's sha256 in structure.json. Use --no-sections when the source states no licence: then only headings and page ranges are kept (AGENTS.md §2.4). A PDF with no outline goes to the pdf-pages rung instead; an inferred chapter tree is never accepted.

inputs.name: no-sections
inputs.description: headings only, for a source with no licence
